artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: Repository-owned call-site manifest, eval suite, fixtures, catalog snapshot, and terminal refresh evidence
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: The evaluator derives exact input digests and accepts refresh evidence only from the current invocation or authenticated complete lineage
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Strict schemas, canonical digests, exact case counts, and terminal-attempt reconciliation
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Repository review plus same-invocation runtime evidence or an externally authenticated exact-head proof
transitions_and_recovery: Missing, stale, contradictory, tampered, replay-only, or non-terminal evidence produces an incomplete run and cannot be repaired by restamping.

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: Canonical Vetryn evaluator using its trusted runtime clock
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.mutable_owner: Evaluator only until canonical serialization and receipt append complete
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: Started and completed times come only from the runner clock and remain bound to evaluator identity and exact evaluation inputs
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Candidate-run schema, evaluation-input digest, artifact-content digest, finite failure codes, and immutable receipt identity
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Same-invocation execution or a verified receipt-chain extension authenticated by a key outside repository-controlled content
transitions_and_recovery: Complete bounded runs become actionable only after all requests, scores, gates, route observations, and receipt bindings reconcile; failed or incomplete runs remain non-promotable.

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.mutable_owner: Receipt store in one append-and-anchor transaction
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: Monotonic sequence, trust-epoch ID, prior-head digest, and exact external anchor head
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Hash-chained canonical entries bind evaluation inputs, artifacts, runner identity, timestamps, and previous head
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Each extension is authenticated with external key material and the exact head is stored outside repository-controlled content
transitions_and_recovery: Append and anchor advance are atomic under a lock; crash, concurrent writer, gap, fork, deletion, truncation, rollback, or missing key and anchor downgrades historical entries to replay-only or rejects them.

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: Built-in schema, required-fact, protected-segment, cost, latency, context, and privacy scorers
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: Bound to scorer identity, version, configuration digest, and exact candidate run
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Every case/repetition is accounted for exactly once and hard gates are derived rather than accepted from provider output
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Canonical evaluator build identity and candidate receipt
transitions_and_recovery: Any hard-gate failure, insufficient coverage, exhausted budget, timeout, invalid output, or privacy violation prevents a complete promotable run.

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: Provider adapter at the request boundary
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.mutable_owner: Provider adapter during each bounded request
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: Bound to request, case, repetition, retry ordinal, reviewed route policy, and candidate model
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Contiguous attempt ordinals and exactly one selected successful provider per completed request
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Untrusted provider metadata is normalized and reconciled by the adapter; it never supplies runner timestamps or policy
transitions_and_recovery: Missing, cached-without-metadata, fallback, model mismatch, provider mismatch, duplicate, or contradictory observations leave the run incomplete.

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Strict core schemas and compiled V1-06 packet
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Manifest, eval suite, JSONL cases, catalog snapshot, refresh lineage, limits, and deterministic scorer configuration
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Reject malformed, duplicate, stale, contradictory, oversized, or unbound inputs before any provider request

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Same-invocation identity or verified receipt chain plus exact external anchor
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Candidate-run artifact, execution receipt, refresh lineage, and prior repository evidence
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Treat imported or historical evidence without current key, anchor, complete chain, and exact bindings as replay-only

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Canonical V1-06 packet and repository product contract
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Allowed paths, offline posture, hard invariants, budgets, retries, tests, and acceptance items
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Stop instead of broadening scope, using live credentials, or weakening non-waivable gates

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Current task implementation grant bounded by allowed paths
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Core contracts, OpenRouter adapter, CLI orchestration, fixtures, tests, docs, and Changesets
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not modify TypeScript scanner, Action, plan state, ledger, progress, workflows, or any other path

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Offline unit, contract, integration, scenario, build, and pack commands
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not run provider, credential, registry, GitHub, or other network-capable commands

authorization_boundary_trace.input: OpenRouter calls, package registry, GitHub writes, or metered model execution
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Produce zero remote calls, writes, and spend; use deterministic offline adapters and fixtures

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Later validation, review, and protected-delivery workers
authorization_boundary_trace.input: CI, review, task promotion, PR, merge, and post-merge state
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Executor records only implementation evidence and does not fabricate lifecycle status

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Evaluation is deterministic, bounded, and accounts for the exact case-by-repetition cross-product.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: Pinned cases, scorer configuration, sampling, attempts, and fixed runner clock emit byte-stable run artifacts.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: Absent cases, required assertions, limits, scorer identity, or evaluator identity reject before execution.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: A changed fixture, evaluator build, policy, catalog, or refresh lineage changes the input digest and prevents reuse.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Conflicting assertions, duplicate case IDs, or inconsistent outcomes produce insufficient or incomplete evidence.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Provider-supplied gates, timestamps, route policy, costs, or success labels are ignored and re-derived.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: A bounded retry may recover only within the declared per-request and total budgets; exhaustion is terminal for that run.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: The scheduler never exceeds configured concurrency and records each request exactly once despite out-of-order completion.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Hard schema, fact, protected-segment, cost, latency, context, and privacy limits cannot be outweighed by quality or savings.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: All deterministic assertions and each independently derived hard gate pass.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: Missing required result fields or route evidence fails closed.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: Stale call-site, suite, catalog, route, or scorer bindings cannot support completion.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Any gate failure or mutually conflicting representative outcomes prevents promotion.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Producer-supplied pass labels, selected providers, or usage values are validated against bounded observations.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Repair requires a new evaluation with corrected reviewed input, never mutation of the old artifact.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Parallel case outcomes are reduced by stable case and repetition ordinals, not completion order.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Actionable execution times and persisted reuse come only from the canonical runner or authenticated exact-head provenance.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: The runner clock supplies ordered times and an authenticated receipt append atomically advances the matching external anchor.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: Missing key, anchor, receipt, or current artifact binding makes historical evidence replay-only.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: An anchor that does not equal the repository log head rejects reuse.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: A receipt whose artifact, input, runner, timestamps, sequence, epoch, or prior head disagrees is rejected.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Append, deletion, truncation, reorder, fork, rollback, restamp, or modified digest fails verification.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: A fresh machine starts a new authenticated epoch for newly executed work and never rehabilitates prior unanchored history.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: A repository lock serializes append plus anchor update; concurrent writers re-read the exact head or fail.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Only the terminal result of a complete ordered catalog-refresh lineage can authorize provider-backed evaluation.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: Current-invocation attempts are contiguous and terminate in the cited successful observation.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: Missing attempt, lineage proof, or exact anchor abstains.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: An older success followed by a newer failure is not actionable.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Duplicate ordinals, multiple terminal results, or a success bound to another snapshot rejects.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Deleted failure, rolled-back head, omitted attempt, fork, or lineage gap rejects.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Run a new bounded live refresh under a new complete invocation lineage; do not reuse the older success.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Refresh attempt ordering is assigned by the canonical orchestrator and reconciled independently of response arrival order.

attack_cases: Modify a run, receipt, prior-head digest, or catalog lineage entry after persistence.
Supply a repository-owned key, forged MAC, unallowlisted verifier, or producer success label.
Restamp an imported run or reuse an older success after a newer failure.
Delete or omit a receipt, refresh failure, request outcome, route attempt, case, or repetition.
Reorder receipt sequence, retry ordinal, refresh attempt, or runner timestamps.
Rollback, truncate, fork, or replace the repository log while retaining an older local anchor.

residual_risks: Offline deterministic adapters prove protocol and safety behavior but do not validate live OpenRouter metadata variations or operational latency.
Cross-invocation actionability depends on external key and anchor storage configured by a later authorized runtime; missing state intentionally downgrades history to replay-only.
